'''Elo Panil''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] that headed a project funded by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to create an [[Kaminoan "super-weapon" project|amphibious super-weapon]]. During [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron's]]&mdash;an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadron&mdash;mission to [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], which was sometime around the first few months after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Panil was discovered to be the only staff-member still present in the research station. According to Panil, the rest of the research team either fled the station or fell victim to the success of the project. Panil was presumed dead after the research station collapsed on top of him during an Imperial bombardment.<ref name="Rebel Force: Firefight">''[[Rebel Force: Firefight]]''</ref>
